objective: Restore readable chronology by auto-expanding occupied/current fixed nighttime bands with active-view-local manual overrides.

context_delta.anti_scope: no configurable hours; no session-wide, local-storage, settings, canonical, or sync persistence
context_delta.dg_01: auto-expand occupied/current early or late nighttime; empty bands compressed; explicit manual collapse allowed
context_delta.dg_02: manual choice scoped to active Day date or Week window and mode; survives same-view rerenders/detail Back; resets on identity change/disconnect
context_delta.memory_preflight: attempted; Crystalium transport closed; zero records
context_delta.week_parity: one shared state per band across seven columns
